sections.heading: Source lineage
sections.text: OneTrust data map produced native record CB-DOC-061-061 for CB-PR-3001. Caleb Hassan owns the source population and Dominic Alvarez recorded the collection review. The export remains separate from later legal analysis.

sections.heading: Business context
sections.text: This record concerns sensitive-data classification within Arcadia genomic data response audit. A consumer access request exposes inconsistencies among genomic-data notices, deletion jobs, vendors, and overseas research transfers. The record addresses one part of the broader question: Join requester identity, genomic data inventory, vendor copies, deletion jobs, and research transfers.
